channel.title: Chepatapa Apps — Build Log
channel.description: How Chepatapa Apps' seven products get built by one developer sharing a single Flutter SDK and an AI-assisted, spec-driven workflow.

item.title: Fitting Flare on the iPhone Duo
item.description: Flare 1.5.0 is built for the foldable iPhone Duo: one-sided safe areas, width caps, short windows, and a bug where folding the phone emptied the log. What the layout sweep found and how it was fixed.

item.title: Describe It: Logging a Hot Flash in One Sentence, With No Server
item.description: Flare 1.4.0 fills its log form from one typed or dictated sentence, using a rule-based parser that runs on the phone in ten languages. How it reads a sentence, why it never auto-saves, and what it can't do yet.

item.title: Five Extra Keyword Fields in the US App Store
item.description: The US App Store also indexes the keyword fields of five other localizations. A made-up word in Flare's Korean listing ranked #1 in the US the day it went live. How the probe worked and how Flare 1.5.0 uses the extra 500 characters.

item.title: Flare 1.5.0 live on iOS and Android
item.description: Flare 1.5.0 fits the foldable iPhone Duo and large text sizes, and Describe it understands more ways to say a time or a duration.

item.title: Torquelle: service photos, export and nine languages
item.description: Torquelle gets photos and receipts on service records, PDF and CSV export of the service book, and translations into nine languages.
